{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Load; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for something heavier and more intense right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: St. Anger Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its raw sound is less appealing to me than the melodic heaviness in my recent listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Mezmerize Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try its mix of aggressive riffs and unusual melodies after Ten Thousand Fists.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hypnotize Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It interests me, but I would choose Mezmerize first this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Core; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its grunge direction is less suited to my current interest in heavier metal.
ItemID: NA; Title: Believe Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Having recently interacted with Ten Thousand Fists, I would choose more of that band's melodic aggression.
ItemID: NA; Title: Meteora; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic hooks fit my interest in The Reason and Chuck, but it is not my first choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Three Days Grace; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose its direct, heavy rock sound given my interest in One Day Remains and Seventeen Days.
ItemID: NA; Title: Shadows Are Security; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try its heavy riffs and melodic passages given my interest in In Flames and Soilwork albums.
ItemID: NA; Title: Sing The Sorrow; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its darker melodic energy interests me, but I would prioritize the heavier selections this time."}
